name: stripe_list_customers
description: List Stripe customers with optional email filter and pagination.

name: stripe_get_customer
description: Get a Stripe customer by their customer ID.

name: stripe_create_customer
description: Create a new Stripe customer with email, name, phone, and optional metadata.

name: stripe_update_customer
description: Update a Stripe customer's details (email, name, phone, metadata, etc.).

name: stripe_delete_customer
description: Delete a Stripe customer and all associated subscriptions and payment methods.

name: stripe_search_customers
description: Search Stripe customers using a query string (e.g. email:'test@example.com').

name: stripe_list_customer_payment_methods
description: List payment methods (cards, bank accounts) attached to a customer.

name: stripe_list_customer_balance_transactions
description: List customer balance transactions (credits and debits applied to a customer's cash balance).

name: stripe_create_customer_balance_transaction
description: Apply a credit or debit to a customer's cash balance.

amount.description: Amount in cents (negative = credit, positive = debit)

name: stripe_list_charges
description: List Stripe charges, optionally filtered by customer or payment intent.

name: stripe_get_charge
description: Get a specific Stripe charge by its charge ID.

name: stripe_update_charge
description: Update a charge's description, metadata, or receipt email.

name: stripe_capture_charge
description: Capture a previously authorized but uncaptured charge.

amount.description: Amount to capture (partial capture if less than authorized)

name: stripe_list_products
description: List Stripe products with optional active filter.

name: stripe_get_product
description: Get a Stripe product by its product ID.

name: stripe_create_product
description: Create a new Stripe product for use in pricing and subscriptions.

name: stripe_update_product
description: Update a Stripe product's name, description, or metadata.

name: stripe_archive_product
description: Archive (deactivate) a Stripe product so it no longer appears in checkout.

name: stripe_list_prices
description: List Stripe prices, optionally filtered by product or active status.

name: stripe_get_price
description: Get a Stripe price by its price ID.

name: stripe_create_price
description: Create a new Stripe price for a product — one-time or recurring.

name: stripe_update_price
description: Update a Stripe price's nickname, active status, or metadata.

name: stripe_list_subscriptions
description: List Stripe subscriptions with optional customer, status, and price filters.

name: stripe_get_subscription
description: Get a Stripe subscription by its subscription ID.

name: stripe_create_subscription
description: Create a new Stripe subscription for a customer with a price or items array.

name: stripe_update_subscription
description: Update a Stripe subscription's items, billing, or metadata.

name: stripe_cancel_subscription
description: Cancel a Stripe subscription immediately or at the end of the current billing period.

name: stripe_pause_subscription
description: Pause a Stripe subscription's collection without canceling it.

name: stripe_resume_subscription
description: Resume a paused Stripe subscription.

name: stripe_list_subscription_items
description: List all items in a Stripe subscription.

name: stripe_update_subscription_item
description: Update a subscription item's price, quantity, or metadata.

name: stripe_create_subscription_schedule
description: Create a subscription schedule to automate future subscription changes (upgrades, cancellations, trials).

name: stripe_get_subscription_schedule
description: Get a subscription schedule by its ID.

name: stripe_update_subscription_schedule
description: Update a subscription schedule's phases or end behavior.

name: stripe_release_subscription_schedule
description: Release a subscription schedule — the subscription continues unmanaged after the schedule ends.

name: stripe_cancel_subscription_schedule
description: Cancel a subscription schedule and optionally cancel the underlying subscription immediately.

name: stripe_list_subscription_schedules
description: List subscription schedules for a customer.

name: stripe_list_invoices
description: List Stripe invoices filtered by customer, subscription, or status.

name: stripe_get_invoice
description: Get a Stripe invoice by its invoice ID.

name: stripe_create_invoice
description: Create a new Stripe invoice for a customer.

name: stripe_finalize_invoice
description: Finalize a draft invoice to make it ready for payment.

name: stripe_pay_invoice
description: Attempt to pay an open Stripe invoice using the customer's default payment method.

name: stripe_void_invoice
description: Void a finalized Stripe invoice (cannot be paid or edited after voiding).

name: stripe_send_invoice
description: Send a Stripe invoice to the customer via email.

name: stripe_create_invoice_item
description: Add a line item to a pending invoice or create a standalone invoice item.

name: stripe_get_upcoming_invoice
description: Preview the upcoming invoice for a customer or subscription before it's generated.

name: stripe_list_credit_notes
description: List credit notes issued for an invoice.

name: stripe_get_credit_note
description: Get a credit note by its ID.

name: stripe_create_credit_note
description: Issue a credit note to partially or fully credit a finalized invoice.

name: stripe_void_credit_note
description: Void a credit note, reversing its effect on the invoice balance.

name: stripe_list_payment_intents
description: List Stripe payment intents, optionally filtered by customer.

name: stripe_get_payment_intent
description: Get a Stripe payment intent by its ID.

name: stripe_create_payment_intent
description: Create a Stripe payment intent for a one-time charge.

name: stripe_confirm_payment_intent
description: Confirm a payment intent to attempt to collect payment.

name: stripe_capture_payment_intent
description: Capture an authorized (but uncaptured) payment intent.

name: stripe_cancel_payment_intent
description: Cancel a payment intent that has not yet been captured.

name: stripe_create_setup_intent
description: Create a setup intent to securely save a customer's payment method for future off-session payments.

name: stripe_get_setup_intent
description: Get a setup intent by its ID.

name: stripe_confirm_setup_intent
description: Confirm a setup intent with a payment method to complete the save.

name: stripe_cancel_setup_intent
description: Cancel a setup intent that is no longer needed.

name: stripe_list_setup_intents
description: List setup intents, optionally filtered by customer.

name: stripe_create_refund
description: Refund a charge or payment intent, fully or partially.

name: stripe_list_refunds
description: List refunds, optionally filtered by payment intent or charge.

name: stripe_get_refund
description: Get a refund by its ID.

name: stripe_get_payment_method
description: Get details about a specific payment method (card info, billing details, etc.).

name: stripe_attach_payment_method
description: Attach a payment method to a customer so it can be reused for future payments.

name: stripe_detach_payment_method
description: Detach a payment method from its customer.

name: stripe_create_checkout_session
description: Create a Stripe Checkout session for one-time payments or subscription setup.

name: stripe_get_checkout_session
description: Get a Checkout session by its session ID.

name: stripe_list_checkout_sessions
description: List Stripe Checkout sessions with optional customer filter.

name: stripe_expire_checkout_session
description: Expire an active Checkout session so it can no longer be completed.

name: stripe_create_payment_link
description: Create a shareable Stripe Payment Link from a price — no code required.

name: stripe_get_payment_link
description: Get a payment link by its ID.

name: stripe_update_payment_link
description: Update a payment link's active status or metadata.

name: stripe_list_payment_links
description: List all payment links in the account.

name: stripe_deactivate_payment_link
description: Deactivate a Stripe payment link so it stops accepting payments.

name: stripe_create_billing_portal_session
description: Create a Stripe billing portal session URL so a customer can manage their subscriptions and payment methods.

name: stripe_get_billing_portal_configuration
description: Get the current billing portal configuration settings.

name: stripe_create_usage_record
description: Report metered usage for a subscription item (for usage-based billing).

name: stripe_list_usage_record_summaries
description: List usage record summaries for a subscription item in a metered billing plan.

name: stripe_list_tax_rates
description: List Stripe tax rates with optional active/inclusive filter.

name: stripe_get_tax_rate
description: Get a tax rate by its ID.

name: stripe_create_tax_rate
description: Create a new Stripe tax rate (e.g. VAT, GST, sales tax).

name: stripe_update_tax_rate
description: Update a tax rate's active status or description.

name: stripe_create_quote
description: Create a Stripe quote — a proposal for a customer before creating a subscription.

name: stripe_get_quote
description: Get a Stripe quote by its ID.

name: stripe_update_quote
description: Update a draft quote's line items, expiration, or metadata.

name: stripe_finalize_quote
description: Finalize a draft quote, making it ready to share with the customer.

name: stripe_accept_quote
description: Accept a finalized quote to automatically create the subscription.

name: stripe_cancel_quote
description: Cancel an open quote.

name: stripe_list_quotes
description: List quotes with optional customer or status filter.

name: stripe_list_coupons
description: List all Stripe coupons.

name: stripe_get_coupon
description: Get a Stripe coupon by its ID.

name: stripe_create_coupon
description: Create a Stripe coupon for percentage or fixed-amount discounts.

name: stripe_delete_coupon
description: Delete a Stripe coupon.

name: stripe_list_promotion_codes
description: List promotion codes, optionally filtered by coupon or active status.

name: stripe_get_promotion_code
description: Get a promotion code by its ID.

name: stripe_create_promotion_code
description: Create a promotion code (human-readable coupon code) for a coupon.

name: stripe_update_promotion_code
description: Update a promotion code's active status or metadata.

name: stripe_list_webhooks
description: List all Stripe webhook endpoints.

name: stripe_get_webhook
description: Get a Stripe webhook endpoint by its ID.

name: stripe_create_webhook
description: Create a Stripe webhook endpoint to receive events at a URL.

name: stripe_update_webhook
description: Update a webhook endpoint's URL or subscribed events.

name: stripe_delete_webhook
description: Delete a Stripe webhook endpoint.

name: stripe_list_events
description: List recent Stripe events — the audit log of what happened in your account.

type.description: Filter by event type e.g. customer.created

name: stripe_get_event
description: Get a specific Stripe event by its ID.

name: stripe_list_files
description: List files uploaded to Stripe (dispute evidence, identity docs, etc.).

name: stripe_get_file
description: Get a Stripe file by its ID.

name: stripe_create_file_link
description: Create a short-lived URL link to a Stripe file for sharing or download.

name: stripe_list_disputes
description: List all Stripe disputes on the account.

name: stripe_get_dispute
description: Get a Stripe dispute by its ID.

name: stripe_update_dispute
description: Submit evidence to counter a Stripe dispute.

name: stripe_close_dispute
description: Close a Stripe dispute, accepting the chargeback (surrendering the funds).

name: stripe_get_balance
description: Get the current Stripe account balance (available and pending funds).

name: stripe_list_balance_transactions
description: List all balance transactions (charges, refunds, payouts, fees).

name: stripe_list_payouts
description: List payouts sent to your bank account.

name: stripe_get_payout
description: Get a specific payout by its ID.

name: stripe_get_account
description: Retrieve your own Stripe account details (business info, capabilities, settings).

name: stripe_update_account
description: Update your Stripe account's business profile or settings.

name: stripe_create_connect_account
description: Create a Stripe Connect account for a platform user (merchant/seller).

name: stripe_get_connect_account
description: Get a Stripe Connect account by its account ID.

name: stripe_update_connect_account
description: Update a Stripe Connect account's settings.

name: stripe_list_connect_accounts
description: List all Stripe Connect accounts on the platform.

name: stripe_delete_connect_account
description: Delete a Stripe Connect account.

name: stripe_create_account_link
description: Create an account link URL for a Connect account to complete onboarding.

name: stripe_create_login_link
description: Generate a temporary Stripe dashboard login link for a connected account.

name: stripe_list_account_capabilities
description: List the capabilities (card payments, transfers, etc.) of a Connect account.

name: stripe_update_account_capability
description: Request or disable a capability on a Connect account.

name: stripe_create_transfer
description: Transfer funds from your Stripe balance to a connected account.

name: stripe_list_transfers
description: List transfers to connected accounts.

name: stripe_get_transfer
description: Get a transfer by its ID.

name: stripe_reverse_transfer
description: Reverse a transfer (pull funds back from a connected account).

name: stripe_list_report_types
description: List available Stripe financial report types (balance, payout reconciliation, etc.).

name: stripe_create_report_run
description: Generate a Stripe financial report for a date range.

name: stripe_get_report_run
description: Get the status and download URL of a report run.

name: stripe_list_report_runs
description: List past report runs.

name: stripe_get_mrr_summary
description: Calculate approximate MRR and ARR from active subscriptions.

description: SUPER TOOL: Find all past-due subscriptions with full customer details — email, name, amount, period end — ready for dunning campaigns.
